title: Unify Git and SQL governance under one governance engine
summary: Establish one automation-core governance engine for Git and SQL governance orchestration while preserving Git history and PostgreSQL data as distinct domain authorities with separate transactions, permissions and failure boundaries.
origin: direct human-governor instruction 2026-10-02: 統一GIT、SQL、治理引擎

changes.proposed: OWNER:automation-core. GOVERNANCE-ENGINE:one registered governance engine is the sole system-wide orchestration boundary for authorized governance workflows,including Git coordination and SQL governance;Git and SQL are domain planes of that engine and never independent schedulers,coordinators or governance authorities. RESPONSIBILITY:the engine receives current decision and permission artifacts,orders dependencies,applies generation fences,coordinates bounded domain executors,joins receipts,isolates conflicts and publishes one convergence result. AUTHORITY-SEPARATION:Git remains authority only for source and immutable repository history;PostgreSQL remains authority only for official mutable structured data and Codex state;the governance engine owns neither domain truth and cannot translate availability in one domain into authority over the other. ATOMICITY:a cross-domain change declares one correlation identity,one intended generation and one ordered transaction plan;Git commit publication,SQL migration or data mutation,verification and activation either converge to the same accepted generation or the affected change remains incomplete and fail-closed;no distributed transaction fiction or silent partial success is permitted. EXECUTION:registered Git and SQL modules perform bounded owner-language work and return typed receipts;runtime-core owns execution mechanics. FAILURE:a failure in one plane blocks only the dependent convergence path,preserves the last accepted state and evidence,and cannot corrupt or promote the other plane. SUCCESS:required Git,SQL,Codex,permission,runtime and audit identities,versions,hashes and receipts agree and independent verification passes.

GIT-ROLE:Git is the source and immutable repository-history plane inside the single C50 governance engine;MAIN:sole stable integration branch;WORKTREES:DIR[DIR_GIT_WORKTREES]+registered ephemeral worktrees;ENTRY:one registered Git adapter only;SCHEDULING:all Git observation,commit,merge,synchronization,audit and delivery work is scheduled only by the C50 governance engine and has no private watcher,coordinator or policy loop;EVENTS:file,HEAD,worker,commit and queue events with bounded reconciliation;TRACKING:allowlist authored source,Codex,contracts,SQL migrations,required configuration,non-rebuildable test or audit evidence and human documentation;IGNORE:runtime state,logs,cache,temp,build output,packages,virtual environments,models,database instances,coverage,generated indexes,rebuildable output and secrets;SELF-COMMIT:stable,path-scoped,no foreign stage and write-lock clear;QUEUE:immutable commit,base,worker,task,priority and policy;CONFLICT:registered generated artifacts regenerate,one canonical owner resolves deterministic content,and every other conflict quarantines and preserves;CROSS-DOMAIN:when a Git change carries SQL migration or governance input,the governance engine binds commit identity,migration identity,target generation and receipts before activation;Git records provenance but never certifies SQL truth;DELIVERY:integrate,audit,verify cross-domain convergence,fast-forward,central equality and origin push;MAINTENANCE:locks,leases,worktree registry,fsck,refs,hooks,divergence and audit continuity;CLEANUP:ignored expendable artifacts only by registered retention and never unmerged work.

SQL-AUTHORITY:PostgreSQL is the sole SQL authority. GOVERNANCE-ENGINE:SQL inventory,migration,drift,security projection,transport,audit,backup,capacity,maintenance and readiness workflows are scheduled only as the SQL plane of the single C50 governance engine;the SQL plane has registered executors but no independent scheduler,coordinator or governance authority. TRIGGER:migration,schema,role,RLS,index,restore,connection-generation and workload-health events. SAFE-ACTIONS:ordered migration,analyze,vacuum,registered additive index,pool or batch adjustment,generation fence,read-only switch and evidence refresh within current authority and permission. GIT-BINDING:SQL migrations carried by Git bind immutable commit identity,migration-chain identity,target schema generation and PostgreSQL execution receipt;Git proves source provenance,PostgreSQL proves applied SQL state,and only the governance engine may join them into a convergence verdict. UNSAFE:destructive DDL,unknown effect,authority conflict,missing receipt or generation mismatch fails closed and quarantines;no alternate SQL engine or manual normal path.
